NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author updated the description with prior-work details and credits, then asked for the label to be removed. There has been no new push since the feedback.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | Description now explains the relationship to #37289 and credits its author with `Co-authored-by`. |
| ❌  | The guide's main ask isn't met. #37289 is still open with "maintainer review", is assigned to @prakhar1144, and was said on 2026-09-04 to be on his list to complete this cycle. There's no sign the original author was asked about it or agreed to hand it off. |
| ❌  | The only screenshot is light mode, but the issue asks for light and dark email clients, and the author's own plan promised both. |
| ℹ️  | Title has an `[ai]` prefix. The author should be able to explain and defend all of the code, including the new color-blending logic. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready", and ask the author to settle with @prakhar1144 and the author of #37289 whether this PR or the original should go forward. If @prakhar1144 wants to finish #37289 himself, close this one.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update! #37289 is still open and assigned to @prakhar1144, who plans to finish it this cycle, so we can't tell yet that this PR should replace it. Please ask @CerealNotFound and @prakhar1144 on #37289 whether they're happy for you to take it over, following the [guidelines on continuing unfinished work](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/continuing-unfinished-work.html). Please also add dark-mode screenshots.
```
